promises.evidence: DECIDED: all of them, not none. The tension recorded earlier today was that one entrant got a measured mid-round review while others had not. The answer, from the Dotfiles lane citing Zaal's standing ruling of 2026-09-27 'always give feedback': every entry PR gets a measured review before the close, the same way. It was never a one-off - reviews had been going out under his grant since that morning. As of 2026-09-27T20:46:25Z every open entry PR on ZAODEVZ/ZAOstock carries one: 11 already did, and the remaining 4 (#317, #318, #316, #354) were posted as COMMENT reviews in that minute. Counted by command, not tallied: 16 open PRs, 1 ours and excluded, 15 entry PRs, 4 + 11 = 15. This promise is about the WRITTEN NOTES at poidhz.com/feedback, which still come after the close, so it is not kept or broken by any of the above - the fairness problem the reviews created is what is settled here, and it is settled by doing all of them. If Vault or Zaal rules otherwise, it stops.
